messages.content: You are the Larkspur Ridge IT help-desk assistant. Answer accurately and concisely using Larkspur's current policies and procedures.
Per RB-NET-001, when do I escalate internet outage triage issues?

Escalate when: Not resolved or no clear ISP ETA within 30 minutes: Tom Kessler; Backup WAN present but did not take over: Tom Kessler immediately; FortiGate shows hardware failure, config loss, or boot loop: Tom Kessler, and onsite via Isaac Brennan; Multiple clients down: Tom Kessler and Marcus Oyelaran; Signs of attack (FortiGate CPU pegged, unusual traffic, firewall policies changed): Tom Kessler immediately.
You are the Larkspur Ridge IT help-desk assistant. Answer accurately and concisely using Larkspur's current policies and procedures.
What is Larkspur's 2026 standard laptop?
The Dell Latitude 5550 with an Intel Core Ultra 5, 32 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a 3-year ProSupport warranty.
You are the Larkspur Ridge IT help-desk assistant. Answer accurately and concisely using Larkspur's current policies and procedures.
What priority guidance does RB-GEN-003 (Onsite visit procedure) give?

Onsite is never a reason to lower priority. A P1 internet outage that needs onsite still has a 4-hour resolution target. If a P1 or P2 needs a tech onsite and none is available within 2 hours, Isaac escalates to Brian Novak, who may pull a Tier 2 tech off the desk.
You are the Larkspur Ridge IT help-desk assistant. Answer accurately and concisely using Larkspur's current policies and procedures.
What disk-space level triggers a Beacon warning alert on a server, and what priority is it?
A warning fires at 15% free space and is a P3, worked within the normal SLA.
You are the Larkspur Ridge IT help-desk assistant. Answer accurately and concisely using Larkspur's current policies and procedures.
When should a technician use the User-reported phishing email runbook (RB-SEC-001)?

Use when a user forwards or reports a suspicious email ("Is this real?"), uses the Report button in Outlook, or admits to clicking a link or opening an attachment in a suspicious email. This is a routine help-desk task.
You are the Larkspur Ridge IT help-desk assistant. Answer accurately and concisely using Larkspur's current policies and procedures.
What priority guidance does RB-HW-001 (Laptop/desktop won't boot) give?

Single user device down, loaner or other device available: P3. Single user device down, no workaround: P3; VIP with no workaround: P2. Multiple devices failing to boot after the same patch night: P1 or P2 depending on scale; escalate immediately (Lena Fischer for patch issues, see RB-SW-002).
You are the Larkspur Ridge IT help-desk assistant. Answer accurately and concisely using Larkspur's current policies and procedures.
What situations does Larkspur's Mailbox full / archive setup procedure cover?

Use when a user gets "Your mailbox is almost full" or "Your mailbox is full" warnings, cannot send mail, or when a client asks for an online archive. Also use when Beacon RMM or the monthly M365 report flags mailboxes over 90% of quota.
You are the Larkspur Ridge IT help-desk assistant. Answer accurately and concisely using Larkspur's current policies and procedures.
Per RB-NET-003, when do I escalate remote access VPN client issues (FortiClient) issues?

Escalate when: FortiGate config changes (user groups, IPsec phase settings, address objects, routes): Tom Kessler; Subnet conflicts with home networks: Tom Kessler; SAML/Entra sign-in errors on the FortiGate app: Renee Castillo; Client asking for a new VPN user or VPN for a new site: P4, Tier 2 with authorized contact approval.
You are the Larkspur Ridge IT help-desk assistant. Answer accurately and concisely using Larkspur's current policies and procedures.
What counts as the metro area for onsite visits?
The Kansas City metro, roughly within 40 miles of the Lenexa office (Johnson, Wyandotte, Jackson, Clay and Douglas counties). Visits outside it are quoted ahead of time.
You are the Larkspur Ridge IT help-desk assistant. Answer accurately and concisely using Larkspur's current policies and procedures.
What does Larkspur charge for server management?
Server management is $175.00 per server per month, for physical or virtual servers.

When should a technician use the Yealink desk phone not registering runbook (RB-VOIP-001)?

Use when a Yealink VoIP desk phone (T3x, T4x, T5x series) shows "No Service", "Registration failed", "Network unavailable", an account line icon that is not green/registered, or the phone has no dial tone. Larkspur supports the phones and the network they sit on.
You are the Larkspur Ridge IT help-desk assistant. Answer accurately and concisely using Larkspur's current policies and procedures.
Per RB-ACC-003, when do I escalate new user onboarding issues?

Escalate when: the request is not from an authorized contact and you cannot reach one: Priya Raman; License purchase or hardware purchase approval is needed: account manager (Alicia Brandt or Kevin Duong); Entra Connect sync errors, duplicate attribute conflicts, or the user never appears in Entra: Renee Castillo; Five or more new users in a week at one client: hand to Rachel Kim (Projects) to coordinate; it may need a quote for device deployment; Client asks for admin rights for the new user: Renee Castillo (we do not grant local admin by default).
You are the Larkspur Ridge IT help-desk assistant. Answer accurately and concisely using Larkspur's current policies and procedures.
When should a windows Update failures ticket be escalated, and to whom?

Escalate when: an update causes widespread issues (several devices or clients): Lena Fischer and Tom Kessler immediately; pause the ring; Server patch failures: Tom Kessler (servers are Tier 3); DISM cannot repair the component store (source files not found): Tier 2; in-place repair upgrade or reimage may be needed (RB-HW-002), with user data confirmed in OneDrive first; Recovery partition too small for an update (common 0x800f0922 with WinRE updates): Tier 2; resizing partitions is a Tier 2 task.

What should the ticket notes include for a laptop/desktop won't boot ticket?

Include: Device asset tag, service tag, model; Symptoms, LED codes, ePSA error and validation codes; BitLocker key provided (yes/no, Key ID only), identity verification method; Repair steps and result, or warranty case number; Loaner provided (asset tag).

What does RB-ACC-004 require in the Harbor PSA notes for user offboarding?

Include: Requester (authorized contact), time of request, requested cutoff time; Exact time sign-in was blocked and sessions revoked; Mailbox disposition and who has access; OneDrive access granted to whom, retention period communicated; Licenses removed, devices recovered (asset tags), contact set Inactive.

Who do clients contact if they think a ticket's priority is wrong?
They can call the support line and ask for the Service Desk Manager, Priya Raman.

What priority guidance does RB-SRV-001 (Server low disk space alert) give?

Warning (15% free): P3, work it within the normal SLA. Critical (10% free): P2. Volume full and services failing (file shares read-only, Exchange/SQL/LOB app stopped, DC replication problems): P1, server effectively down; use RB-SRV-002 alongside this runbook. After hours: critical alerts on Premier servers are worked by on-call per RB-GEN-002. Professional only if it is a P1 (server down). Warnings wait for business hours.
You are the Larkspur Ridge IT help-desk assistant. Answer accurately and concisely using Larkspur's current policies and procedures.
What access or tools do I need before working a shared mailbox and calendar permissions ticket?
You need: Exchange admin center via GDAP (Exchange Administrator); Exchange Online PowerShell (Connect-ExchangeOnline).

Include: Callback number used and authorized contact name and time (for resets); Method enrolled (Authenticator push with number matching) and old methods removed; TAP issued (yes/no, by phone); never record the TAP value; Test sign-in result.

$6.00 per user per month, with 14 daily restore points. It is included at no extra charge in Professional and Premier.

Write the Harbor PSA resolution note for this ticket.
Client tier: Professional
Category: Security Report / phishing_report
Priority: P3
Subject: I think I clicked a bad link
Description: Following up on something. I got a really strange email this morning from what looks like one of our vendors. It says their bank account changed and that we should send this month's payment to a new account, and there's a PDF attached with 'updated wire instructions'. The email address looks almost right but there's an extra letter in the domain name I think. I didn't open the attachment. The weird thing is it replies to a real conversation we had with them last month, so it has our old emails at the bottom. Should I call them? I don't want to be rude if it's real but this doesn't feel right. I've attached the email. Please let me know what to do before Friday because that's when we usually pay them.

Issue: Payment change fraud attempt.
Cause: Vendor email compromise (vendor side).
Resolution: Advised client to verify bank change by phone with known number; blocked lookalike domain.
Verification: Confirmed with user that issue is resolved.
Runbook: RB-SEC-001
You are the Larkspur Ridge IT help-desk assistant. Answer accurately and concisely using Larkspur's current policies and procedures.
